title: RecoveryEvent
description: DESIGN-level schema. Represents a recovery-event record per architecture/reliability/FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY_MODEL.md. No concrete safe-state values or timeouts are prescribed here.

recoveryEventId.description: Unique identifier for this recovery event.

failureClass.description: Category of failure, as enumerated in FAILURE_AND_RECOVERY_MODEL.md.

detectionSource.description: Component that detected the failure (e.g., Watchdog, Deterministic Control).

stage.description: Current stage of the recovery workflow for this event.

containment.description: Description of isolation/containment action taken, if any.

safeState.description: Reference to the applicable safe-state definition. Use [UNRESOLVED_SPEC: Requires Hardware/Code Verification] if not yet defined for this failure class.

escalationOwner.description: Actor or role responsible for escalation if automatic recovery does not succeed.

recoveryAction.description: Action taken during RECOVER stage, if reached.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed for this stage before escalation. Null if undefined. Do not fabricate a value.

rollbackCondition.description: Condition under which this recovery is rolled back rather than completed.

verificationCondition.description: Condition that must hold true for VERIFY stage to pass.

evidenceEmitted.description: Evidence record IDs produced by this recovery event.
